acquisition method: The Orbitrap Eclipse was operated in data-dependent mode.
alkylation reagent: proteins were alkylated using 10 mM IAA for 30 min at ambient temperature (approximately 22 °C) in the dark.
alkylation concentration: proteins were alkylated using 10 mM IAA for 30 min at ambient temperature (approximately 22 °C) in the dark.
cleavage agent: For all samples, trypsin in 100 mM TEAB in water was added to the S-Trap.
enrichment method: the SEC-enriched pool corresponding to the void peak was treated using Top 14 protein depletion columns.
fractionation method: Filtered ascites or plasma-derived serum samples were loaded onto a 1.5 × 12 cm Sepharose CL-4B gravity flow column
fragmentation method: the most abundant ions/scan were selected for fragmentation by higher energy collision dissociation (HCD).
instrument: coupled to an Orbitrap Eclipse Mass Spectrometer.
ionization type: Peptides were eluted directly from the tip of the column and nano sprayed into the mass spectrometer.
labeling: Peptides identified using bottom-up proteomics yielded 1–8% coverage of MUC16.
reduction reagent: proteins were denatured and reduced simultaneously using 0.4% DCA, 10% SDS, and 10 mM TCEP with incubation at 95 °C for 10 min.
reduction concentration: proteins were denatured and reduced simultaneously using 0.4% DCA, 10% SDS, and 10 mM TCEP with incubation at 95 °C for 10 min.
